eyebrow: The boring case: a product state
code:
|+> (x) |+> = [(|0>+|1>)/sqrt2] (x) [(|0>+|1>)/sqrt2]
            = (|00> + |01> + |10> + |11>) / 2

normalization: 4 x 0.25 = 1   (OK)

FACTORS -> qubit 1 is |+>, qubit 2 is |+>, independently
caption: Two separate qubits sitting next to each other — measuring one tells you nothing new about the other.

eyebrow: The Bell state: refuses to factor
code:
|Phi+> = (|00> + |11>) / sqrt(2)

assume: (a|0>+b|1>)(x)(c|0>+d|1>) = ac|00>+ad|01>+bc|10>+bd|11>

need: ac=1/sqrt2, ad=0, bc=0, bd=1/sqrt2
ac != 0 -> a,c both nonzero
bd != 0 -> b,d both nonzero
but ad=0 needs a=0 or d=0 -> CONTRADICTION
caption: Four linear equations that are jointly unsatisfiable, for any a, b, c, d. The two qubits have no individual states of their own.
